row.reason: AZZ sells hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating, which are metal coating services and coated coil. IES is an electrical and mechanical contractor with custom power equipment, and it is adding structural steel through DBM Global. IES has no coating offering. Both serve infrastructure and industrial markets, but their products and revenue models differ. AZZ earns service fees on customer-owned steel and sells coated coil. IES earns money from installation contracts.
